source: Medical Injury Compensation Reform Act (MICRA), Stats. 1975, Ch. 2 (2d Ex. Sess.)
wound_addressed: Open-ended SOL exposure; actuarial unpredictability driving medical malpractice insurance crisis
design: 1-year discovery + 3-year outer absolute limit; four exceptions preserved (minor, fraud, foreign body, disability)
